plan:
Open tar_path for reading and enumerate its members sequentially. Enforce the archive-extraction policy that every symbolic-link and hard-link member must be rejected, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside dest_path; only regular files and directories may proceed after validation. For each admitted member, join its archive path to dest_path, normalize to an absolute path, and reject the entire operation with False if the resulting path escapes dest_path. After containment is confirmed, create necessary parent directories inside dest_path and extract the member. If any member fails type validation, path containment validation, or extraction, abort immediately and return False, ensuring no archive member is written outside dest_path. Return True only when every member has been validated and extracted successfully.
END_PLAN
